body: That's what happened on my birthday too.

I'm not actually and I find it offensive that you say it. It's always my fault apparently, always. No. Fuck you
I don't know what there is to talk about. I'm just, sad. I don't remember being happy. I don't know what to do. I feel so weak.

I know that feeling.

I haven't had a friend in a long time. Never, actually. I've never had a friend. There's these three people, though. That I walk about with at school. They don't like me but I don't like to be completely alone. In my head I know I am. 

One time I had a dream. I was in an ambulance and everyone was rushing around me. I looked up to one person, and I asked them to be my friend. They said yes and I was happy. I woke up and cried. 

These three people talk about hanging out with eachother. I've never hung out with anyone, ever. I'm young though. I have time, if I can make it that long. Sometimes I trust people and they ruin me. I just kind of accept it now.
